summary: Whatcom County site near Deming, WA: 80-ft pole tower 1929, 75-ft steel tower 1947, DNR tower 1965, removed 1985; cab now at the Forks Timber Museum.

facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1985; the cab was moved to the Forks Timber Museum and is on display there

events.note: Register: first used with an 80-foot pole tower. Weebly describes the earlier structure differently and gives no date.
Aircraft Warning Service station activated August 17, 1942 (Weebly)
Aircraft Warning Service station deactivated October 16, 1943; the State kept the site as a fire lookout
75-foot steel tower with 8x8 cab replaced the earlier tower
40-foot wooden DNR tower. Weebly dates the replacement 1964-66.
Tower removed. Register and Weebly agree on 1985.
Cab moved to the museum at Forks (WillhiteWeb: removed to Forks in 1985)

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the structure before 1947: the register says an 80-foot pole tower in 1929, while Weebly says a small tower of native materials with no date. The DNR tower's dates differ slightly (register 1965; Weebly 1964-66; WillhiteWeb gives 1965 for the cab). The museum's name also differs: the register says Forks Museum, the WillhiteWeb heading says Forks Timber Museum; the story uses both. The brief's status 'relocated' fits the cab only, since the tower was removed in 1985. No source names lookouts or gives staffing years, so no facts.staffing is recorded. No source describes the mountain site today, and the display's current status and hours are not verified. Access is left out for the same reason. Reads: 2 WebSearch-equivalent queries (websearch.py) and 6 page reads, one of them a guessed Forks URL that returned 404.
